item.name: Sync automation from latest Git release

request.name: Sync automation from latest Git release

description.content: Reconciles automation registry metadata and trigger projections from the latest Git source release. This operation is idempotent for unchanged source state: repeated calls against the same latest release leave the same automation registry state and may repeat the same warnings. Requires a Bearer API token for the organization and a user-backed API key. It does not publish source; it reads the already-published latest release manifest. Versioned targets are rejected with 400, missing organization/source/release/manifest state returns 404, invalid manifests return 400, and provider or persistence failures return 5xx.

variable.description: (Required) Automation target to sync, such as agents.invoice-agent or workflows.extract. Do not include a version; sync always uses the latest Git release.

response.name: Automation metadata, latest release information, and non-fatal sync warnings.
